_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is the signal — with 95% of 12h windows flat and divergent flow data contradicting the bullish analog, HOLD is the skilled call until either ETF inflows confirm accumulation or VIX/funding break signals a leg down.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls Disbelief forward with HOLD direction; narrative implies rotation but does not commit to a forward phase, so consensus defaults to the analyst's ±1 legal call
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive (>20) AND stablecoin_growth recovers above 45 with btc_momentum_30d holding >45
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks >20 with funding spiking >0.01% AND btc_momentum_30d drops below 35 — signals Panic leg down
